guide.summary: Roman, Byzantine and Ottoman monuments, state and MOMus museums and the reopened central market, with brunch, dinner, cocktail, bakery and coffee stops checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Plan around split closing days: the MOMus museums (except the Experimental Center for the Arts) and NOESIS close on Mondays, the Archaeological Museum of Thessaloniki, the Rotunda and the Heptapyrgion close on Tuesdays, and the White Tower opens daily.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The MOMus museums (except the Experimental Center for the Arts) and NOESIS close on Mondays, while the Archaeological Museum of Thessaloniki, the Rotunda and the Heptapyrgion close on Tuesdays. The White Tower opens daily, and the Museum of Byzantine Culture opens daily through November, then closes on Tuesdays from 1 December.

toolkit.label: Free Sundays
toolkit.copy: Hellenic Heritage lists free admission at the Archaeological Museum of Thessaloniki, the Rotunda and the Heptapyrgion on the first and third Sunday of each month from November 1 to March 31. Otherwise full tickets are €10 at each of them and €8 at the White Tower.

toolkit.label: White Tower entry
toolkit.copy: The White Tower admits up to 70 visitors at a time and has no toilets, refreshments, cloakroom or luggage storage, so travel light. Last admission is 20 minutes before closing.

toolkit.label: Booking
toolkit.copy: Clochard takes table reservations by phone, email or online, and Orizontes Roof Garden books its 19:00–23:00 dinner service online or on +30 2310 294 036.

guide.dek: Check each sight's closing day before you plan, because Thessaloniki's museums split between Monday and Tuesday closures.
intro: Thessaloniki's headline monuments are listed by the Ministry of Culture's Hellenic Heritage platform, and their pages give you clear winter schedules. The White Tower opens daily from 08:30 to 15:30 between November 1 and March 31, with last admission 20 minutes before closing and no more than 70 visitors inside at once. The Rotunda and the Heptapyrgion keep the same winter hours but close on Tuesdays, as does the Archaeological Museum of Thessaloniki, which lists 09:00 to 17:00. All three offer free admission on the first and third Sunday of each month from November 1 to March 31.

The Museum of Byzantine Culture opens daily through November and closes on Tuesdays from 1 December. Its photography exhibition 'Olympos. Earth, People, Light', with pictures by Satsi from post-war Pieria, runs until 27 January 2027, and a show on the ancient architecture of Huizhou opens on 14 November 2026 and runs to 14 February 2027. The Archaeological Museum lists a temporary exhibition from 18 November 2026 to 31 May 2027. At the Teloglion Foundation of Art, 'Metzikof. A world of wonders' runs until 31 January 2027, and the Museum of the Macedonian Struggle marks Messolonghi 1826–2026 until the same date.

The MOMus museums close on Mondays and stay open until 20:00 on Thursdays at the Museum of Modern Art, the Museum of Contemporary Art and the Thessaloniki Museum of Photography. At the Museum of Modern Art, 'Behind the Doors. Costakis meets Rubinstein' runs until 10 January 2027 beside the permanent Costakis Collection. The Museum of Contemporary Art shows 'K.BHTA. Only the coastline remains' until 31 January 2027, and the Hamza Bey Mosque (Alcazar) on Egnatia shows Pete Marifoglou's photographs of the city in 1960–1980 until 31 March 2027. A myMOMus Card covers one visit to each venue within six months.

For food, Ergon Agora Thessaloniki on Pavlou Mela serves brunch from 09:00 to 14:00 and stays open until 01:00 every day, and Ergon's pastry shop Tzeneral nearby lists 08:00 to 00:00. Clochard on Mitropoleos opens 13:00 to 00:00, Monday to Sunday, and takes reservations by phone, email or online. Orizontes, on the top floor of Electra Palace on Aristotelous Square, serves dinner from 19:00 to 23:00 and says it has been included in the MICHELIN Guide. Agora Modiano, the historic central market at Ermou and Vasileos Irakleiou, has 32 independent stalls, according to its operator Ergon.
summaryCards: Pair the White Tower, which opens daily, with the Archaeological Museum of Thessaloniki, which closes on Tuesdays.
Ergon Agora Thessaloniki serves brunch from 09:00 to 14:00, and Terkenlis on Tsimiski lists 07:00 to 00:00 every day.
Clochard takes reservations by phone, email or online, and Orizontes Roof Garden books its 19:00–23:00 dinner service online or by phone.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several official sites could not be read: modiano.gr, zythos.gr and tsarouhas.gr returned certificate errors; ouzoumelathron.gr, kitchenbar.gr and mourga.gr did not resolve; charoupi.gr, pemf.gr and daiosluxuryliving.gr failed DNS lookups; valenio.gr refused the connection; odysseus.culture.gr refused the connection; makedoniapalace.com redirects to plain http. Published only partially: Thessaloniki Concert Hall and Teloglion box-office or opening hours were not readable; the Museum of the Macedonian Struggle showed only a same-day closing banner; Agora Modiano and Fellows Bar publish no hours; the Rotunda and Heptapyrgion evidence is the current Hellenic Heritage listing with no dated 2026 notice; Coffee Island, Mikel Coffee, Terkenlis, Tzeneral and Balboa are confirmed from current store lists or hours rather than dated news, and Balboa's street number differs between 42 and 44 Pavlou Mela on the same page. The Museum of Byzantine Culture's own visit page lists Tuesday closure for the whole winter, while its homepage says it is open daily through November; the guide follows the homepage. The Jewish Museum of Thessaloniki was left out for lack of dated current content.
